optionalSeparateOperations.name: Selective portable installation
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Separate installer projection, not extra init output. The receipt is private. Root START-HERE differs from startup .bowerloom/START-HERE.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Startup revision history
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Private transaction marker and retained history for explicitly approved revision or recovery. These are siblings of .bowerloom, not children.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Harness projection state
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Optional synthetic harness projection with separate exact approvals. Caller selects state directory and config file; no canonical .bowerloom/harness directory. Original bytes and receipts remain private. Removal files exist only after the corresponding operation.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: MCP planning inputs
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Read-only planning consumes three existing absolute paths. Declarations are portable. Bindings, catalogs, source identities, and output plans are private. No standard .bowerloom/mcp directory is generated. Internal discovery APIs do not establish a public connect command.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Local connection receipt
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Separately approved local link writes a receipt outside both project roots. It neither merges definitions nor grants execution.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Local control registry
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Default private registry for separate local control registration. Startup registers no work. An explicit registry location can replace the default.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Local backend installation
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Separate backend plan and exact approval. Credentials and environment files remain private. Docker Desktop is an existing prerequisite. Startup installs no backend. Backend installation alone does not provision execution runtime.

optionalSeparateOperations.name: Private execution installation
optionalSeparateOperations.boundary: Execution and recipe services require explicit private configuration and separate approvals. These are not startup-generated project files or automatically installed connections.

plannedOnly.description: Issue #66 proposes versioned routines referencing existing recipes, teams, skills, and approved MCP declarations. No routine filename, generator, or public routine command was established by inspection. Scheduling and event triggers remain deferred.

documentationNotes.description: The tutorial says .bowerloom/startup-review.md and bare START-HERE.md. Init generates .bowerloom/START-HERE.md. The separate portable installer generates workspace-root START-HERE.md. README line 117 and AlphaGuide line 46 already use the startup path.
Routines belong in a future panel, not the current generated startup tree.

presentationRules: Startup neither executes teams nor imports project context.
Do not combine the separate portable-installer layout with the init tree.
Portable text still requires review for private brief and goal content.
Do not show proposed output/scope.md, output/draft.md, or output/review.md as existing files.
Historical trellis/ formats and alpha compiler versions are compatibility identifiers; preserve their bytes.
